I have notes on 2 emails.
Read each with `mp show <selector>` (a draft: `mp path <selector>`), carry out the instruction, and close it with `mp notes done <selector> --result "..."`.
A note without a selector asks for a new email: write it with `mp -A <account> new`, then close it with `mp notes done --id <id> --result "..."`.
Never send or approve anything.
